title: defaultQueueStartTime probeTimeoutMs argument has no deterministic test: mutating it back to the hard-coded 5000 survives the pid-reuse file
evidence: Mutation "timeout: probeTimeoutMs" -> "timeout: 5000": file-job-queue.pid-reuse.test.ts still 8 pass / 0 fail, because on an unloaded host the real probe is fast and the argument only matters when the probe exceeds 5 s.
fix_direction: Add a test that passes a tiny probeTimeoutMs (e.g. 1) for a live foreign pid on win32 and asserts null, and a generous one asserts non-null; or note as accepted.
class: test strength, not a product defect
